LESSON: IMPORTANCE OF FOOD IN OUR BODY

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.4: Importance of food in our body

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Importance of food in our body. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. tell how to choose fruits eaten within their locality,
2. wash fruits before eating to prevent illnesses,
3. appreciate the importance of washing fruits before eating to prevent illnesses. water) fruits to eat search for other fruits eaten.

2. wash fruits before eating to prevent illnesses,

3. appreciate the importance of washing fruits before eating to prevent illnesses. water) fruits to eat search for other fruits eaten.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of washing fruits before eating to prevent illnesses. water) fruits to eat search for other fruits eaten. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Importance of food in our body.
2. Explain Importance of food in our body to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Importance of food in our body.
4. Show that you can: tell how to choose fruits eaten within their locality,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Importance of food in our body. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Importance of food in our body important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. tell how to choose fruits eaten within their locality,
2. wash fruits before eating to prevent illnesses,
3. appreciate the importance of washing fruits before eating to prevent illnesses. water) fruits to eat search for other fruits eaten.
